title: Closure under majority
statement: A verifier model $E$ is closed under majority if, for every Boolean-output verifier $M$ and natural numbers $a,k,a',k'$, whenever the Boolean verifier associated with $M$ is efficient in $E$, the majority verifier using block length $n\mapsto a(n+1)^k$ and repetition count $n\mapsto a'(n+1)^{k'}$ is also efficient in $E$.
hypotheses_covered: the Boolean verifier associated with $M$ is efficient in $E$
